record.original_question: A semicopula is a nondecreasing map S:[0,1]^2 -> [0,1] with neutral element 1 and S(x,y)<=min(x,y). Characterize all semicopulas S for which the subadditivity-type inequality S(x+y,z) <= S(x,z) + S(y,z) holds whenever x,y,z are in [0,1] and x+y is still in [0,1].

evidence.quote: Problem 9.1 (O. Hutnik). To characterize all the semicopulas S for which the inequality S(x + y, z) <= S(x, z) + S(y, z) holds for each x, y in [0, 1] such that x + y in [0, 1].

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A semicopula is a function $S:[0,1]^2\to[0,1]$ that is nondecreasing in each argument, has $1$ as a neutral element (i.e. $S(x,1)=S(1,x)=x$ for all $x\in[0,1]$), and satisfies $S(x,y)\le\min(x,y)$ for all $x,y\in[0,1]$. Characterize all semicopulas $S$ for which the subadditivity-type inequality
\[
S(x+y,\,z)\;\le\;S(x,z)+S(y,z)
\]
holds for every $x,y,z\in[0,1]$ such that $x+y\in[0,1]$.
artifact.status_search_result: Web search returns related work by Hutník and collaborators on subadditivity, Hölder, and Minkowski-type inequalities for semicopula-based (seminormed) integrals, but no source explicitly provides a complete characterization of semicopulas satisfying S(x+y,z) ≤ S(x,z)+S(y,z) on the stated domain. The current status of the precise characterization problem could not be verified.

status_evidence.snippet: Borzová-Molnárová, Halčinová, Hutník study properties and characterizations of semicopula-based integrals including subadditivity-type properties.
status_evidence.claim: Related characterization work on semicopula-based integrals, but the specific pointwise inequality characterization is not stated as resolved.
